title: Add groom skill with AC validation checklist
story: As a developer, I want a groom skill that runs an interactive checklist against a ticket's story and AC before it enters a sprint, so that known gaps are caught and resolved before execution rather than discovered mid-implementation.
acceptance_criteria: A groom skill exists that accepts a ticket ID
The skill defines and runs a checklist against the ticket's story and AC interactively with the user
When a checklist item fails, the agent flags it, offers suggestions, and gives the user the option to edit the ticket before continuing
sprint-start invokes the groom skill for each ticket during the grooming step instead of doing ad-hoc analysis
